component.name: VLC Redesign
component.summary: VLC media player with the interface redesigned by Juxtopposed

description.p: VLC Redesign is an unofficial build of VLC media player whose interface follows the design from "I Redesigned VLC After 25 Years" by Juxtopposed: near-black layered surfaces, VLC orange as the single accent colour, a slim sidebar and a compact player bar.
VLC media player is made by the VideoLAN team and contributors. This build is not affiliated with or endorsed by VideoLAN.
